concepts.label: Savings as rented bearing capacity
differentia: Operator: Contributions of any size and timing become parts that carry a standing load others depend on; the dependents pay the owners in proportion to the measured load each part carries, and the same dependence locks the parts in service, so claims can change hands but the capital cannot be withdrawn.
Payout steadiness comes from the slow change of the load borne, not from the saver's earnings or from asset prices.
There is no withdrawable pot: the lock is functional, because the structure needs the part, not a rule that could be waived.

Distinguished within Regularity supplied by others by: what the others supply: a standing dependence that pays rent to the saver's part (bearing), a maintained continuity that accrues to the saver (relay), or their own later surplus, paid oldest claim first on claims the saver holds (surplus-settled claims)

Distinguished within No pot a lean month can raid by: where the saved value lives so that a lean month cannot take it: in parts others depend on, in the length of a chain others keep, or in parcels already in transit
concepts.boundary: Same family whatever the carried load (power, water, housing, transport or storage capacity), the meter or the enforcement of the due. A new family when payout does not come from a standing dependence of others on the saver's contribution, for example when it comes from spreading contributions over time or from a continuity that a group maintains.

state_schema.bearing_stock: the accumulating parts built from contributions, counted by what is present
state_schema.held_dependents: those whose standing depends on the parts
state_schema.standing_due: the rent the dependents pay for as long as they are held
state_schema.load_meter: the measurement of what each part carries, which sets its share
state_schema.functional_lock: the dependence that keeps a part in service until a replacement takes its load

concepts.label: Continuity produced by a relay and owned by the kept
differentia: Operator: A value that grows superlinearly with the unbroken span of a maintained state, and restarts its count at a gap, is produced for each member by a rotating pool of intermittent maintainers who are released and credited only when a successor confirms takeover; each pays in whatever resource is spare, so continuity is a property of the member rather than of anyone's regularity.
Accrual is keyed to an unbroken chain that others produce, not to the member's own payments.
The only regularity asked of anyone is a short overlap at handover; only exit, never a lean month, breaks the chain.

Distinguished within Regularity supplied by others by: what the others supply: a standing dependence that pays rent to the saver's part (bearing), a maintained continuity that accrues to the saver (relay), or their own later surplus, paid oldest claim first on claims the saver holds (surplus-settled claims)

Distinguished within No pot a lean month can raid by: where the saved value lives so that a lean month cannot take it: in parts others depend on, in the length of a chain others keep, or in parcels already in transit
concepts.boundary: Same family whatever is maintained (a locked pot, coverage, a contribution record, a personal tie) and whatever the currency of contributions. A new family when value does not depend on the unbroken span of a maintained state, or when keeping the continuity is the member's own duty.

state_schema.maintained_party: the member whose value depends on how long the maintained state has gone unbroken
state_schema.intermittent_maintainers: the irregular contributors who each hold the state for a while
state_schema.overlap_handover: the rule that no one releases until a successor confirms takeover
state_schema.superlinear_span_accrual: value that grows faster than the span and restarts at a gap
state_schema.successor_minted_record: the record in which each credit is issued by the successor at takeover

concepts.label: Regularity supplied by others
differentia: Operator: The steadiness a saver cannot supply is supplied by a structure of other people: the benefit is keyed to something others depend on or maintain, never to the saver's own regular payments.
Separates designs where the collective carries the regularity from designs where it is carried by time, by the saver, or by the physics of the medium.
concepts.boundary: A hypothesis introduced at the second family; keep it only if later families fall under one of its children or clearly outside it.

concepts.label: Averaging by irrevocable temporal scatter
differentia: Operator: A fixed fraction of each irregular inflow is cut when it occurs and released irrevocably in parcels staggered over many future periods into a common collector, so each later period's intake averages many earlier inflows; the collector pays out a fixed fraction of its stock, shared by credit relative to each period's average.
The steadiness comes from where in time the contributions are placed, not from the saver's regularity, others' dependence, or a relay's upkeep.
Nothing is held in between: parcels are in transit and cannot be withdrawn, lent or steered.

Distinguished within No pot a lean month can raid by: where the saved value lives so that a lean month cannot take it: in parts others depend on, in the length of a chain others keep, or in parcels already in transit
concepts.boundary: Same family whatever carries the delay (dated claims, maturity ladders, physical drift) and whatever the spread or the payout fraction. A new family when the averaging is done by pooling across people at one time rather than across time, or when contributions can be recalled before they land.

state_schema.proportional_tap: the fixed fraction cut from each inflow when it occurs
state_schema.scatter: the placement of each cut across many future periods
state_schema.irrevocable_carrier: what holds each parcel in transit so that no one can recall it
state_schema.collector: the common pool that receives parcels as they land
state_schema.fixed_fraction_draw: the payout of a fixed fraction of the collector each period
state_schema.relative_credit: credit measured against each period's average cut

concepts.label: No pot a lean month can raid
differentia: Operator: The saved value is kept in a form that the saver cannot draw down in a lean month, so contributions made at any time survive to old age.
A lens on how savings are protected, crossing the lens on who or what supplies the regularity.
concepts.boundary: A cross-cutting hypothesis introduced at the third family; keep it while later families either share the move or clearly lack it.

concepts.label: Commitment by hindsight on proven-idle value
differentia: Operator: Nothing is committed when it arrives. A meter tracks the part of an ordinary spendable balance that the owner's own use has left untouched over a trailing window; a fixed fraction of that proven-idle part is locked irrevocably at each step, and any draw-down lowers the mark and pauses the lock, so what becomes locked is chosen after the fact by the owner's revealed need rather than by a pledge, a forecast or a share of inflows.
The commitment is sized and timed by the owner's own past need, observed over a window, not by a pledge, a forecast, a fixed share of inflows, or others' dependence.
Money stays within reach until need has had a full window to claim it; only what the window spared is locked, so the lock never takes what the window showed was needed.
concepts.boundary: Same family whatever the window length, the freeze fraction or the locked store, and whether the idle mark is a trailing minimum or another measure of untouched value. A new family when the lock falls at arrival (then it is a share of inflows), when the owner chooses the amount, or when the locked store itself, rather than the selection, is what protects the value.

state_schema.spendable_balance: the ordinary account every inflow reaches and every expense leaves
state_schema.idle_meter: measures the part of the balance untouched over the trailing window, net of what is already locked
state_schema.lock: moves a fixed fraction of the idle part into an irrevocable store at each step
state_schema.store: holds locked value until old age; ordinary, not the source of the protection

concepts.label: Claims settled only out of the debtor's later surplus
differentia: Operator: What exceeds a holder's reserve is split between a locked holding and interest-free claims on other members. A claim is never demanded on a schedule: it is settled only out of the debtor's own later excess, oldest claim first, wherever the creditor is, so a lean interval is never asked for anything. What others still owe a holder sets its priority for scarce shared capacity, so outstanding claims have value while they wait, and support that will never be returned gives the most lasting priority.
Repayment is triggered by the debtor's surplus, not by time, a schedule or a pledge, and seniority orders it across creditors.
Being owed is itself productive: outstanding claims buy priority in scarce work, which funds carrying members who will never repay.

Distinguished within Regularity supplied by others by: what the others supply: a standing dependence that pays rent to the saver's part (bearing), a maintained continuity that accrues to the saver (relay), or their own later surplus, paid oldest claim first on claims the saver holds (surplus-settled claims)
concepts.boundary: Same family whatever the unit of account, the share sealed, the reserve size or the scarce capacity that rank orders. A different family when claims earn interest or fall due on a schedule, when settlement comes from the debtor's whole income rather than its excess, or when rank is bought rather than earned by claims outstanding.

state_schema.reserve: the holding filled first; only what exceeds it enters the relation
state_schema.claim: an interest-free, never-expiring amount one member owes another
state_schema.router: takes the share of a debtor's later excess meant for others and pays its oldest creditors first
state_schema.rank: priority for scarce shared capacity equal to claims still owed to the holder
state_schema.locked_holding: the sealed part of each excess, released only on agreed terms

partition fam.no-raidable-pot.by-where-value-lives, lens: where the saved value lives so that a lean month cannot take it: in parts others depend on, in the length of a chain others keep, or in parcels already in transit
aspect: when value leaves the owner's reach: at contribution, before need is known, or after a trailing window of need has passed it by
aspect: both commit a fixed fraction without a pledge or a forecast; they differ in when the fraction is taken and in what makes taking it safe
aspect: both make a lean month cost nothing by letting only surplus act: a proven-idle balance there, the debtor's later excess here

concepts.label: Steady old-age income decoupled from when and how much the saver earned
differentia: Operator: old-age income is steady even though the contributions behind it were lumpy and irregular
concepts.boundary: About income adequacy and steadiness; not about care, company or being known.

concepts.label: Old age held by people who know you, with care that does not lapse
differentia: Operator: old age arrives with continuous care and with people who know the person, whatever the person's earnings history
concepts.boundary: About care, company and being known; income may accompany it but is not the defining claim.

concepts.label: Saving that never deepens a lean month
differentia: Operator: no money that the saver later needs is ever locked away, so building an old-age claim never makes a lean month leaner, whatever the income pattern
The benefit is felt during the working years, as the absence of harm from saving, not in the shape or security of old-age income.
It is claimed for every contribution, not on average: each locked amount has already shown it was not needed.
concepts.boundary: Same class whatever protects the lean month: locking only money shown to be spare (a trailing low, an elapsed window, an unclaimed buffer), or demanding nothing in a lean month and covering it from others' surplus. A different class when the claim is steady old-age income, care in old age, or a larger total saved.

concepts.label: Relational support by conserved load paths
differentia: Operator: Any configuration steeper than its material's repose generates an outward demand that grows superlinearly with its height; the ambient medium answers it only up to a threshold scale, and the thing can never answer it itself. The remainder is answered only by one-sided contact from the side the demand points toward. Equal opposing demands cancel; unequal ones pass their difference cumulatively along unbroken contact chains to a single sink, which accepts it only when enough ballast accompanies it. Removing any link unanswers everything upstream at once, and unanswered excess relaxes the configuration irreversibly toward its ground state, so ascent requires temporary scaffolding.

Stability is extrinsic, conserved and passively borne: not a property of the thing, not paid by ongoing effort, not dissipated with distance, but a standing load carried by neighbors and routed to a ground sink. Its signature consequences are density economies through cancellation, the whole net burden at the outer boundary and cumulative at chain ends, weight as both liability (when raised) and asset (when grounding), instant upstream cascades, and ratcheting loss.
Standing holding mode: a configuration paid once in ballast or anchorage, with no running cost; its demand is signed, so equal opposing demands cancel.

Distinguished within Held metastability: excess order persists only while a holder answers its relaxation, and holding moves the unbalanced pressure into the holder, never dissolving it by: holding mode: standing (a configuration paid once in ballast or anchorage; instant transmission; no memory; instant upstream cascade) versus running (an act paid per moment held; compulsory holder rest in which the holder must be held; stored tenure; gradual failure)
concepts.boundary: Same regime (instance or alias) when only the carried quantity (thrust, obligation, debt), the bearer, the input that generates demand (height, rank, speed), the threshold, the scaling exponent, the sink ratio or the ground-state shape changes. New regime when the primary operator changes: things can hold themselves up (intrinsic strength or tension); the demand decays along the chain instead of being conserved; it is paid by effort per unit time rather than borne statically; equal opposing demands add instead of cancelling; or there is no sink, so demand must circulate or be stored. Changing only the failure semantics (reversible slumps, no centering needed) is a candidate specialization, not a new regime; a world keeping the ratchet and scaffolding but dropping conserved routing belongs to a different regime.

concepts.label: Observational upkeep: specific detail persists only under unbroken, resolution-limited attention, and the holder carries the decay it prevents as a burden shed only in rest
differentia: Operator: Specific detail drains spontaneously and one way: first to its kind's typical form, then down a ladder of kinds to a Ground that needs no holding. Drain is fastest on the intricate and new, near nil on the typical. The only counter is unbroken attention by an active, discerning holder. It only keeps: it never creates or restores, and it resists net loss of detail, not motion or accretion, harder the more is at stake. It holds exactly what some holder can resolve, a resolution set by sense, distance, breadth and understanding, pooled across holders. Gaps under a grace interval do not count, so relays must overlap. Holding is a running act: the drain it prevents is conserved, accruing in the holder as burden for as long as it holds. Co-holders share it, each holder has a capacity, and overflow drains the holder's own detail. Burden discharges only in the holder's rest, when it holds nothing and must itself be held.

Operator, continued: Unbroken holding accrues tenure superlinearly with span, and a break restarts the count; tenure shields the unwatched thing until spent. Kinds sum the tenure of all their members, so old kinds are deep attractors and a new kind falls into the nearest old one.

Against regime.relational-load-path: holding is running, not standing. Load paths cost nothing once built and ballasted; upkeep costs burden for every moment held and forces the holder into periodic rest, where it must be held in turn, so relays, rotas and a daily tide replace a fixed structure. The conserved quantity is unsigned and never cancels, only moves or is shared in parallel, whereas opposing loads cancel. Fidelity is bounded by the holder's representation (grain), which contact support lacks. Continuity is stored as tenure, so failure is delayed and local, not an instant upstream cascade. The ground is a nested, history-weighted ladder of typical forms rather than one repose state, and an active holder can partly hold itself.

Distinguished within Held metastability: excess order persists only while a holder answers its relaxation, and holding moves the unbalanced pressure into the holder, never dissolving it by: holding mode: standing (a configuration paid once in ballast or anchorage; instant transmission; no memory; instant upstream cascade) versus running (an act paid per moment held; compulsory holder rest in which the holder must be held; stored tenure; gradual failure)

Boundary, continued: this regime's kind-tenure clause rather than join it. Borderline test: does the prevented decay reappear in the holder, and does protection end when attention breaks for longer than the grace?
concepts.boundary: In: worlds where specific detail, form or memory lasts only while an active holder attends to it without a break; the holder keeps but never makes or restores; and the decay held off is charged to the holder over time and must be discharged in rest. Instance-level changes: who holds (animals, machines, spirits, the dead), which senses set the grain, the grace length, the tenure exponent, the rest mechanism. Out, as candidate siblings or splits: (1) observation that creates, selects or collapses states is generative, not keep-only; (2) periodic re-performance that restores lost detail (ritual refresh, recopying) is restorative, whereas vigil restores nothing; (3) protection that costs the holder nothing, or burns a fuel while the prevented decay reappears nowhere, lacks the conserved burden; (4) holding by a standing configuration with no running cost belongs to regime.relational-load-path under the shared parent; (5) drift toward prototypes with no holder at all (pure tradition attractors) would split off

concepts.label: Held metastability: excess order persists only while a holder answers its relaxation, and holding moves the unbalanced pressure into the holder, never dissolving it
differentia: Operator: A state above its ground carries a one-way pressure to relax toward that ground. The state cannot answer the pressure by its form alone; the answer must come from a holder, which is a structure or an act distinct from what it holds. Holding does not dissolve the unbalanced pressure: it moves it into the holder, which must pass it to a sink. Holders therefore need holding, holding capacity is the scarce resource, the amount of order a world can carry is bounded by that capacity, and whatever is raised or new needs intensive temporary holding until it sets. Unanswered excess relaxes irreversibly.

Separates worlds whose order is kept by a conserved pressure routed through holders from worlds whose ordered states sustain themselves (stable attractors, autocatalysis, self-repair), worlds where decay is only slowed by barriers that bear nothing, and worlds where upkeep burns a fuel without the prevented decay reappearing anywhere. Children are cut by holding mode. Standing: a configuration pays once (ballast, anchorage), transmits instantly, keeps no memory and fails as an instant upstream cascade (regime.relational-load-path). Running: an act pays per unit time held, forces holder rest, stores continuity as tenure and fails gradually (regime.observational-upkeep).

Distinguished within Answered decay: left alone, a thing's state does not stay; it relaxes, lapses, unravels or drifts, and it lasts only while something outside it answers that tendency by: what answers the tendency: borne (a distinct holder takes the displaced pressure and must pass or shed it; failure is one-way relaxation) versus unborne (an ambient feed that others induce; nothing accrues in suppliers; failure is two-sided, starving or tearing)
concepts.boundary: Introduced as a hypothesis on the second world. Keep it only if a later world falls under it without fitting either child, or if the standing/running cut predicts a world's consequences (instant cascade versus tenure; fixed structures versus rotas and rest). Collapse it if every later member is plainly one child. Not a home for every world where things decay without care: membership needs one-way relaxation to a ground, holding by a structure or act distinct from the held form, and the unbalanced pressure reappearing in the holder and passing to a sink. Possible further children: periodic re-performance, if the prevented decay still lands on the performers; hybrids in which a standing structure must also be tended.

concepts.label: Twinned induction: things are conserved signed turnings of one medium, born and cancelled only in opposite twins; nothing moves or feeds itself; each is carried and fed by others' stir
differentia: Operator: Every thing is a standing turning of one medium that can only flow; it keeps no material, only its pattern. Each carries a signed, conserved turn. Turn is made only together with an equal twin of opposite sign; equal opposites meeting annihilate into fine paired spray, which is heat; like signs within a threshold merge, and unlike ones cancel in part. Nothing can move or sustain itself. Each thing is carried and fed only by the flow the others induce, instantly and at any range, fading with distance. So like signs circle their shared center; an equal opposite pair travels straight, faster the closer, and an unequal pair curves toward the stronger; a lone thing goes only where ambient flow carries it or along a boundary, which answers it with an opposite-signed mirror partner. A turning lasts only inside a band of ambient shear: too little and it unravels, spreading its turn diffusely; too much and it is torn to spray.
Operator, continued: Every turning is also a sink that draws the medium into an inward spiral with no stable orbit, so all things drift toward some eye.

Against held metastability: decay is answered not by a distinct holder that takes on the displaced pressure, but by the pattern itself consuming an ambient gradient; nothing accrues in a supplier, no holder needs rest or holding, and failure is two-sided (starving or tearing), not one-way relaxation of excess. What is conserved is the order's own signed quantity, not the pressure against it: death spreads turn, never destroys it. Power is pairing, not bearing or keeping: a thing moves only with an opposite partner or its mirror at a wall, and every steer is a conserved transfer of turn. Interaction is an instant long-range field in which opposites cancel, not contact chains or attention.

Distinguished within Answered decay: left alone, a thing's state does not stay; it relaxes, lapses, unravels or drifts, and it lasts only while something outside it answers that tendency by: what answers the tendency: borne (a distinct holder takes the displaced pressure and must pass or shed it; failure is one-way relaxation) versus unborne (an ambient feed that others induce; nothing accrues in suppliers; failure is two-sided, starving or tearing)

Boundary, continued: Outside, to relational load path: worlds where opposing demands cancel statically and the net passes through contact chains to a ballasted sink; here cancellation is annihilation or co-travel, imbalance steers, and there is no contact. Outside, as regimes still to be admitted: throughput-fed patterns with unsigned quantities or self-propulsion, which share only the feed band and would justify a 'fed pattern' parent opposed to held metastability; and conserved signed charges that act by contact or push themselves, which lack company-only motion.
concepts.boundary: Inside: worlds whose things are signed, conserved quantities that arise and cancel only in opposite sets and cannot move themselves, moving only in the field the others induce, whatever the medium, names, ranges or thresholds. Changing the merge distance, the field's fall-off, the shear-scaling law, the width of the livable band, the number of signs (if they are made only in cancelling sets), or dropping the world-whirl changes parameters, not the regime. The feed band is part of the operator as found here; a world that keeps twins and company-only motion but lets things last unfed stays inside as a specialization under a persistence cut, not a new root. Outside, to held metastability: worlds where order is kept by a structure or act distinct from it that takes on the displaced pressure and must pass it to a sink or shed it in rest. Rote reciters here resemble vigil keepers but supply feed, not holding: nothing accrues in them and nothing is shed.

concepts.label: Paid change: unattended state is kept exactly; every change is an agent's conserved, signed expenditure, lodged in what it changed and refundable only by its maker until overwritten
differentia: Operator: Things have no natures or tendencies, only conditions, and an unattended condition is kept exactly: nothing falls, coasts, cools, decays or is forgotten; there is no ground, up or down. The only cause is an agent spending a single conserved currency by direct touch; a change in any direction costs currency equal to its size. Non-agents receive and keep change but never pass it on, so there are no mechanisms, chains or cascades. Spent currency is not consumed: it lodges in the change, signed by its maker, who alone can undo it for a full refund, and only while nothing has changed that thing since, so later work locks earlier work in stack order. No agent can take another's currency or alter another; it can only give currency, which cannot be refused. A witnessed transfer between agents creates an exact, permanent, bilaterally netted obligation that seizes the debtor's later agent-directed outflows, oldest creditor first, at any range.

Operator, continued: Witnessed renunciation fixes a change forever and deletes its currency from the world, so total currency only shrinks. What an agent is owed, plus what it has renounced, sets how fast it can spend.

Against answered decay: there the unattended drifts and persistence must be supplied, by a holder that bears the displaced pressure or by a feed nobody bears; here the unattended is kept exactly and only change is bought, once, in any direction. Against observational upkeep, its nearest by shared structure, it is the dual: acts only change, keeping is free, and the maker can restore. The spent quantity is not a live pressure passed to a sink but an inert, signed deposit only its maker can reclaim, so making is saving and every change is attributable and reversible until built over. Causation is agent-only and contact-only, with no transmission through things; only debt seizure acts at range. A coupled binding operator turns the ledger into rank: being owed sets pace.

Boundary, continued: Out: any world where something changes unattended, even slowly, belongs under answered decay, even if agents also pay for change; worlds whose stillness is itself held by an agent's act (a freeze that must be sustained) are held metastability, since there keeping is what is paid. A world where change propagates through things (levers, contagion, chains of cause) has a mechanism rather than this operator. Newtonian inertia is out, because there motion coasts and here nothing does. Occasionalist worlds in which one agent causes every change at no cost are out too: nothing is paid, so nothing is ledgered.
concepts.boundary: Necessary: the unattended state is kept exactly, with no spontaneous dynamics of any kind (no relaxation, momentum, diffusion or decay), and every change is caused by an agent paying for it, at a cost set by its size, by direct action on the thing. Full fit adds what the first instance shows: the payment is conserved, lodged in the change under its maker's name and reclaimable only by the maker until overwritten; witnessed transfers between agents create netted obligations that seize outflows; being owed sets pace; renunciation destroys currency. A world that keeps inert state and paid change but dissipates the payment (no refunds, no signatures) is a partial fit and the test of a partition by the fate of spent currency; one that drops binding, or binds without tying rate to claims, is a partial fit and the test of a partition by what a transfer between agents does.

concepts.label: Answered decay: left alone, a thing's state does not stay; it relaxes, lapses, unravels or drifts, and it lasts only while something outside it answers that tendency
differentia: Operator: Every ordered thing is off the rest point of some spontaneous tendency: relaxation toward a ground, lapse toward the typical, unravelling, or an inward spiral. It cannot answer the tendency by its own form; it lasts only while something outside it does, and unanswered it degrades irreversibly. What must be supplied is persistence, not change: the unattended changes by itself, and effort or feed goes into staying. Worlds under this concept differ in what answers and what answering costs the answerer: a distinct holder that takes the displaced pressure into itself and must pass or shed it, failing one way, by relaxation, when holding lapses; or an ambient feed that others induce and nothing bears, failing two ways, by starving or tearing. Scarcity follows the answer: holding capacity where the answer is borne, a livable band of feed where it is not.

Names the premise that held metastability and twinned induction share and that stayed invisible until a world lacked it: the unattended drifts, so persistence has to be supplied. Their recorded opposition, borne holder versus unborne feed, becomes this concept's partition (by-answerer). The contrast class is paid change, where the unattended is kept exactly and only change is bought, so effort goes into altering rather than staying.
concepts.boundary: In: any world whose things have a spontaneous tendency away from their present state (toward a ground, the typical, dispersal or a sink) and persist only through an outside answer, whether a holder, a feed, a field or an act, and whether the answer is paid once or per moment. Both former roots sit here unchanged: held metastability under the borne branch, twinned induction under the unborne branch. Out: worlds where the unattended state is kept exactly (paid change); worlds whose unattended states change without degrading toward any rest point, such as purely reversible oscillation, which neither this concept nor paid change covers and which should be admitted on its own if it appears. A world with a slow drift plus paid change stays in, because some persistence must still be answered.

aspect: analogies, not identities: unbroken contact chain and overlapping relay within the grace; scaffolding and curing vigils; withdrawing support and averting or the Turning; ballasted sink and sleep under a night-keeper; height and thisness at stake; repose and the Ground or the typical

aspect: analogies, not identities: equal opposites cancel and only the net acts; the outer boundary completes the balance; one missing element sets the whole going

aspect: how imbalance acts: cancellation by annihilation or co-travel in a contactless field where imbalance steers motion, versus static cancellation passed by contact chains to a ballasted sink with instant upstream collapse
aspect: analogies, not identities: rote reciters and carousel archives against the unbroken watch; the unfed widen into faint swirls as the unwatched go typical; a sealed room is a small Eye

aspect: what the outlay becomes: an inert, signed deposit only its maker can reclaim, so making is saving, versus a live pressure moved into a holder that must pass it to a sink

aspect: change-only versus keep-only: here acts only alter, keeping is free and the maker’s undo restores for a full refund; there the watch only keeps and nothing restores; unwatched records last forever versus only while watched

aspect: analogies, not identities: debt and burden, conserved loads that accrue in persons, never fade and end only by a specific act (repayment or forgiveness versus rest); standing earned by unreturned giving and tenure by unbroken keeping; the stilled, kept until woken, and the resting keeper who must be held; perception as a paid running act

aspect: what dependency does to removal: work built on top locks the buried change against its maker’s undo, versus removing a link unanswers everything upstream at once; here building needs no support

aspect: analogies, not identities: one netted balance per pair, where only the net binds, and equal opposing demands that cancel so only their difference acts; reckoners tracing debt chains and redirected payments, and net load passed along contact chains

aspect: analogies, not identities: a witnessed gift makes an equal and opposite pair, the receiver’s debt and the giver’s claim, which repayment annihilates and over-repayment flips, as turn is made and unmade only in opposite twins; things cannot move themselves; debt seizure is the one action at range, like stir

aspect: who pays for what: every change is paid by a self-moving agent’s touch in an inert world, versus nothing paid, with things fed and carried by contactless induced flow and unable to last or move alone
